resources.string: Styles subtitles drawn by LumaFin. Subtitles burned into video and external players may use their own appearance.
Move subtitles up from the bottom of the video. Higher percentages place them farther up; subtitle tracks with their own placement may behave differently.
Restore brightness, text size, weight, text color, background color and outline color. Position and playback timing stay as they are.
Restore the bottom offset to 8%. Appearance and playback timing stay as they are.

While watching, open the subtitles button to select a track or adjust its timing. Timing applies to the current video and resets for a different video. Burned-in subtitles cannot be retimed by LumaFin.
PGS, ASS and subtitle burn-in options.
Move subtitles earlier or later in 0.1-second steps, up to 30 seconds either way. Reset restores only subtitle timing to 0 for the current video. Press Back to close.
Move audio earlier or later in 0.1-second steps, up to 2 seconds either way. Reset restores only audio timing to 0 for the current video. Press Back to close.
